gloss: traces; vestiges; image; reminder of someone

definitions.gloss: traces; vestiges; remains of past appearance
definitions.explanation: Visual or recognizable remnants of how something or someone used to be.

definitions.gloss: image; likeness; features reminiscent of someone
definitions.explanation: A resemblance to someone, often a family member, visible in appearance or manner.

examples.japanese: この{町|まち}には{昔|むかし}の{面影|おもかげ}がない。
examples.english: This town has no traces of its former self.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}には{母親|ははおや}の{面影|おもかげ}がある。
examples.english: She has traces of her mother in her features.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}の{頃|ころ}の{面影|おもかげ}が{残|のこ}っている。
examples.english: Traces of their childhood appearance remain.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
{面|おも} (face, surface) + {影|かげ} (shadow, image) → the image/memory of a face

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{面影|おもかげ}がある (to have traces/resemblance)
・{面影|おもかげ}を{残|のこ}す (to retain traces)
・{面影|おもかげ}を{偲|しの}ぶ (to reminisce about someone's image)
・{昔|むかし}の{面影|おもかげ} (traces of the past)

NUANCE:
{面影|おもかげ} often carries a nostalgic or wistful tone, used when remembering how things used to be or seeing a resemblance to someone from the past.

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{名残|なごり} (traces, remnants) - broader meaning, includes non-visual traces
・{面影|おもかげ} - specifically visual/appearance-related traces
